newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket up $1.61 in week to $20.86.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket up $1.61 in week to $20.86.

text.p: The average export price for Venezuela's basket of crude and oil products increased $1.61 to $20.86 per barrel on Friday, compared to $19.25 the previous week, the Energy and Mines Ministry said.
The average price for the year so far is $17.73 per barrel, the ministry said in a statement. Venezuela's oil export price averaged $14.84 last year, up from $13.23 in 1994.
The Venezuelan government has based recently revised 1996 budget calculations on an average price of $17.00 per barrel.
Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said this week this target would most probably be met.
